description: Manage Visual Spec baseline contracts (Visual SDD). Actions: "set" registers a screenshot or design mockup as baseline, "verify" tests a live UI screenshot against a baseline, "list" returns all registered visual specs.

file_path.description: Absolute file path to image (for 'set' or 'verify')

sdd_requirement_id.description: Optional state-memory-mcp SDD requirement node ID for 'verify'

tolerance.description: dHash Hamming distance tolerance threshold for 'verify' (default: 8)

name: manage_visual_spec
